title: Existence of God
definition: The existence of God is the truth that the living God truly is, eternally existing as Creator, Lord, and Sustainer of all things.
summary: God is real, eternal, self-existent, and the Creator of everything that exists.
christFocus: Jesus Christ reveals the living God perfectly, making the invisible God known and calling people to know the Father through Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture begins with God. It does not argue as though God were one idea among many; it declares, 'In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.' The existence of God is the foundation for creation, truth, morality, worship, accountability, and hope.

God is not dependent on creation. He is not a force, an idea, or a projection of human need. He is the eternal, living Lord who made all things and sustains all things by His power. Creation bears witness to Him, and conscience reminds humanity that life is lived before Him.

The fullest revelation of God comes through Jesus Christ. No one has seen God in His fullness, but the Son has made Him known. To know Christ is to be brought into the truth of who God is and to be called into worship, trust, repentance, and obedience.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: If God does not exist, life has no final foundation for truth, purpose, dignity, judgment, or hope. But because God is real, every person matters, every sin is accountable, every promise of God is meaningful, and every call to seek Him is urgent. This doctrine confronts unbelief and anchors the heart in reality.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live as one who is seen, known, and sustained by the living God. Worship Him as Creator, seek Him through Christ, and resist the temptation to live as though your life belongs to yourself. Let the truth of God's existence shape your decisions, priorities, and hope.
